function.name: air_quality_forecast
function.description: Retrieve an air quality forecast for a specific location and time frame. Unlike weather_forecast, which retrieves a weather forecast, this retrieves an air quality forecast.

location.description: The city that you want to get the air quality forecast for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.

function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieve a weather forecast for a specific location and time frame. Unlike air_quality_forecast, which retrieves an air quality forecast, this retrieves a weather forecast.

location.description: The city that you want to get the weather for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.

function.name: news
function.description: Retrieve news articles for a specific topic.

topic.description: The topic that you want to get the news for.

days.description: Number of past days for which to retrieve the news.
